digest.component_or_area: janitor approval & derisk investigation: RP-02 through RP-06 recovered decisions
propositions: Recovered RP-02 through RP-06 approval decisions on 2026-08-16 were lossy and require evidence-backed research and durable decision-ready briefs before becoming implementation stories.

RP-02 transaction semantics require ordered exact-match retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary with no-op repetition and safety-abort on ambiguity or replacement failure, not general multi-file ACID atomicity.

RP-03 retry ownership must be singular at the adapter level with bounded physical invocation/sleep envelopes, write-ahead postconditions, commit_unknown re-observation, and scoped finite-pass fuse (3 consecutive exhausted outcomes across ≥2 tickets), not exception-class-dependent blast radius.

RP-04 operation-snapshot supplies validated resolved config authority via explicit>environment>project>user>default precedence with separate secret/provider boundary and central defaults, correcting prior CLI-over-environment tracker precedence and removing Cloud adapter-local fallbacks.

RP-05 CLI routing normalizes canonical package-data help for every visible top-level command pre-operation (before RP-04 snapshot/config/mount/handler/optional imports), with alias-specific help for compatibility shims and hidden-but-helpable bridge-status.

RP-06 effective applicability reversal and activated-project-DET routing visibility require code-review criterion evaluation against effective policy with parity-first typed unit outcomes and success-only checkpoints, deferring posture-aware normalization.
